_costBasis: list -- every modelUsage block here carries costBasis: list, so these are list-price equivalents and not a bill
_source: claude -p --output-format json --model claude-sonnet-5 / claude-fable-5, run 2026-08-26 to reconcile the two rates #81 says are missing. One prompt each, reading a file twice so the run bills a cache write AND a cache read rather than input alone -- a rate solved from input+output only is one equation that cannot see the multipliers. Both arms also bill claude-haiku-4-5 for harness-side work, which is the control: the existing $1.00 rate must still reproduce its costUSD exactly. The .jsonl beside this file are the real transcript records reduced to the fields parse_line reads; they are what supplies the cache-write TTL split, which modelUsage aggregates away.
